node -e "require.resolve('playwright-core')" 2>&1

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable chrome headless_shell 2>&1
find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "*chrom*" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -iv node_modules | head -20
find / -maxdepth 8 -iname "*headless_shell*" 2>/dev/null | head
mkdir -p /tmp/pw-verify && cd /tmp/pw-verify && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm install playwright@1 >/tmp/pw-install.log 2>&1; tail -20 /tmp/pw-install.log; echo EXIT:$?
cd /tmp/pw-verify && timeout 100 npx playwright install chromium --with-deps > /tmp/pw-browser-install.log 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; tail -40 /tmp/pw-browser-install.log
cd /tmp/pw-verify && timeout 100 npx playwright install chromium > /tmp/pw-browser-install2.log 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; tail -40 /tmp/pw-browser-install2.log
cat /etc/os-release 2>&1; which apt apt-get dpkg dnf yum 2>&1; id; ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -i nspr

sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo "sudo ok" || echo "no sudo"
which sudo 2>&1
sudo dnf install -y nss nspr atk at-spi2-atk cups-libs libdrm libxkbcommon libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm alsa-lib pango cairo 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /tmp/pw-verify && cat > verify-reduced.mjs <<'EOF'
import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox'] })
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } })
await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })
const errors = []
page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(m.text()) })
page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(String(e)))

await page.goto('http://localhost:3411', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForSelector('.product-card')
const link = page.locator('.product-card', { hasText: 'Classic Sneakers' })
await link.click()
await page.waitForTimeout(30)
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/pw-verify/07-reduced-mid.png' })
await page.waitForSelector('.product-price')
console.log('errors:', JSON.stringify(errors))
await browser.close()
EOF
node verify-reduced.mjs
lsof -ti:3411 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill 2>&1; rm -rf /tmp/pw-verify; echo done

pid=$(cat /proc/net/tcp 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1{print}' | grep -i ':0D5B' ); ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3411; fuser -k 3411/tcp 2>&1 || pkill -f "next dev -p 3411" 2>&1; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 2 http://localhost:3411/ || echo "server down"
pkill -f "next dev -p 3411" 2>&1; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 2 http://localhost:3411/ 2>&1 || echo "server down"
